prs.title: Clamp discounts so an invoice total can never go negative
prs.body:
Fixes #9.

A discount code above 100% (we saw `SPRING110` in production) made `applyDiscount` return a negative total, so the customer was shown "-$1.00 due".

`applyDiscount` now clamps the percentage to 0-100. Added a test for 110% and for a negative percentage.

prs.title: Add toCsv() to export invoice lines
prs.body:
Our accountant asked for invoice lines as CSV so they can be pasted into a spreadsheet.

Adds `toCsv(lines)` in `src/csv.js`: one header row, then `description,qty,unit,total`, with money formatted by the existing `formatMoney`. Descriptions containing commas or quotes are quoted per RFC 4180. Documented in the README, with a test.
